description: Department of Fiscal Policy "Center for Handicapped"Organization Approved for Charity Purpose under the Inland Revenue Act. (24/2017)
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification issued under the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017. It contains a statutory declaration by the Minister of Finance approving an organization as a charity for tax purposes. While it mentions a named minister, the primary purpose is regulatory - implementing a specific provision of tax law rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
